strategies.title: Pre-Scripted Go/No-Go 4th Down Embedded Decisions

strategies.rationale: While analytics universally agree that passing on early downs is highly efficient, models are silent on true fullbacks because the modern sample size evaporated a decade ago. strategies.recommendation: Deploy a true fullback (21 personnel) on over 50% of first downs, but throw the ball 65% of the time from this heavier alignment.
strategies.title: 21 Personnel Pass-First Base Offense
